method: Manually compared private four-panel contact sheets against the approved mockup source, checking seen, stored-cold, unseen, and cold released-loading states. Screenshot appearance is supported by the recorded DOM facts; screenshots cannot establish animation duration.

cells.finding: Muted preview, formula placeholder boxes, expanded active rail and question card, no top badge. Unknown geometry begins with its question and alone carries the unseen suffix/bottom fade. Released loading keeps the preview and shows spinner/loading text.

limitations: The mockup is light mode; dark captures keep the existing dark palette. Narrow captures naturally have a more overlapping rail card. The 120 ms fade and busy-tick animation are code/test checks, not a claim established by a still image. Some early captures contain a local replay draft; final cleanup clears it and verifies emptiness after reload. Raw screenshots remain private.
